place_fields.summary: Shettyhalli Anjaneya Swamy Temple is a Hindu temple and tourist attraction in Shetty Halli, Tumakuru.
place_fields.best_time: During the listed opening hours; daily opening is reported.

planning_attributes.description: Located at 846F+799, Shetty Halli, Tumakuru, Karnataka.
planning_attributes.how_to_reach: The temple is in Shetty Halli and Tumakuru railway station is reported as about 2.08 km away.
planning_attributes.access_restrictions: Listed opening hours are 08:30-12:15 and 17:00-19:15 daily.

place_fields.vibe: Pilgrimage temple in a rural setting near Theetha reservoir
place_fields.summary: Sri Mahalakshmi Temple at Goravanahalli is dedicated to Goddess Mahalakshmi and is a major pilgrimage site in the Tumakuru district.
place_fields.best_time: Tuesdays and Fridays are considered especially auspicious; the temple is open year-round.

planning_attributes.description: The temple is at Theeta Post, Koratagere Taluk, Tumkur District, Goravanahalli 572129.
planning_attributes.legend_or_history: The main Mahalakshmi idol is believed to be self-manifested; sources describe local worship beginning in the early 20th century and renewed temple activity by Kamalamma in 1952.
planning_attributes.how_to_reach: Goravanahalli is accessible by road; sources report KSRTC/private bus connections and Tumakuru as the nearest railway station.
planning_attributes.access_restrictions: The temple trust currently lists temple timings as 06:30 AM to 08:30 PM; special religious schedules may alter access.
planning_attributes.notes: The temple trust lists services including special darshan, abhisheka, kumkuma archane and homa.
